description:
MonitorBankRates has tracked bank and credit union rates since 2008. This plugin connects ChatGPT to the same live database that powers MonitorBankRates.com: about 150,000 current rate quotes from more than 8,000 U.S. banks and credit unions, refreshed daily from each institution's own published rates.

Ask for the best rates on CDs (3 to 60 months), high-yield savings, money market and checking accounts, mortgages, home equity loans and HELOCs, auto loans, personal loans, and credit cards — nationally or in your state — and get one best quote per institution with the minimum deposit and the date it was collected.

Check today's average rate for any product and whether it's moving up or down over the past week, month, or quarter. Look up any bank or credit union to see every rate it offers alongside its MonitorBankRates financial health grade, star rating, and Texas ratio from the latest FDIC or NCUA filing.

You can also pull the MBR Housing Affordability Index, updated daily with state rankings, and the annual Home and Auto Insurance Burden Indexes.

Every answer is dated, credited to MonitorBankRates.com, and linked to the matching page. No account or sign-in required.

How have 30-year mortgage rates moved over the past month?
Is my bank financially healthy, and what does it pay on savings?
